# Kavik Works
> Kavik Works (Robot Arms LLC) is a Denver business offering written workflow blueprints for small service businesses and property teams.

## Current offer
- Workflow Blueprint: $149 USD one time for one intake or follow-up workflow.
- Email josh@kavikworks.com first to confirm fit, scope, and delivery timing before payment. Email first if you need sales tax confirmed before you pay. This website does not calculate sales tax.
- If you already know the workflow, pay $149 at the Stripe-hosted checkout (https://buy.stripe.com/dRm14oc0c9g0fiXgn4bZe00) and email the details afterward. If the project does not fit, you can request a refund: https://kavikworks.com/refunds
- Stripe collects card numbers on its checkout page. Do not email payment details. This website does not collect card numbers.
- Includes a workflow map, capture fields, routing rules, three editable templates, setup steps, a test checklist, and one clarification revision within seven days of delivery.
- Prepared with AI assistance and checked against the customer brief. No call, account, or inbox access.
- This is a written plan. Installation, live inbox operation, and ongoing monitoring are not included. No customer results, conversion lift, or time savings are claimed.
- Current focus: quote requests, leasing inquiries, and shared administrative inboxes. Medical, legal, financial, and tenant-screening decisions, and emergency dispatch, are outside the offer.
